snippet.title: Amber Alert - Console trailer
snippet.description:
Amber Alert plunges you into a terrifying night as a lone police officer responding to a missing person call. What starts as a routine investigation quickly descends into a nightmare as you uncover a sinister cult operating in the shadows  👀

Navigate eerie, deserted streets and abandoned houses, facing off against a cult of women abductors who will stop at nothing to protect their dark secrets. With limited resources and the ever-present threat of danger, your survival depends on your wits, your courage, and your ability to make split-second decisions 😨

Can you rescue the missing girl and escape the clutches of this terrifying cult?
